capabilities.wealth_summary: KIB is a fully Shariah-compliant bank (Islamic since 1 Jul 2007) with a banking-led affluent tier and a newly built investment arm. Affluent tiers are the Black package (total deposits of KD 100,000+ or monthly salary of KD 3,000+; dedicated relationship manager, priority service) and a Premium package (benefits only; threshold not shown), with no private banking unit found. Investment activity sits in Al Dawli Invest Investment Company (KIB Invest, 99.9% owned, launched Nov 2024) which offers asset and portfolio management, funds and advisory; its first product is the Al Dawli Invest Islamic KD Money Market Fund (launched 2025, weekly dealing, USD and EUR strategies planned) and it acts as joint lead manager on sukuk (USD 1bn Islamic Development Bank, USD 700m FAB, USD 2.75bn Saudi Real Estate Refinance Co, 2026). No AUM, brokerage, robo or managed-portfolio offer was found. KIB Mobile adds investment-deposit and card journeys; investment deposits opened in-app doubled in H1 2026. Strategy 2024-2028 aims to 'revitalise the core' and expand client propositions in priority segments through targeted partnerships and digital initiatives.

initiatives.what: Launched KIB Invest (Al Dawli Invest) as Islamic investment arm: asset management, fund and portfolio management, advisory; Chairman Anwar Bukhamseen, CEO Jamal Al-Barrak.
Al Dawli Invest Islamic KD Money Market Fund launched (IFN: 2 Feb 2025; Albawaba release dated 27 Apr 2025); USD and EUR strategies planned.

YE2025 call: progress on digital and operational transformation and on 'selectively leveraging partnerships and digital channels'; operating expenses up 13% to KD 59.6m mainly on digital initiatives and staff costs.
Abdullah Al-Asousi appointed General Manager of Financial Control and Planning (search summary).
KIB Invest joint lead manager on the USD 2.75bn Saudi Real Estate Refinance Company sukuk; earlier in H1 2026 JLM on a USD 1bn Islamic Development Bank sukuk and participant in a USD 700m FAB sukuk.

H1 2026 call: second phase of Strategy 2024-2028 with focus on 'expand our client propositions' across priority segments, digital capabilities and 'targeted partnerships and digital initiatives'; call led by Jassim Al-Abdulhadi as Acting CEO.
Retail Banking reported H1 2026 digital results: accounts opened via KIB Mobile doubled year on year, investment deposit openings doubled, instant credit card issuance, ATM network 141 machines.
Priced inaugural USD 500 million five-year senior unsecured Sukuk under a USD 1.5bn programme (settlement 10 Sep 2026).

opportunities: Strategy 2024-2028 (second phase) targets expanding client propositions in priority segments and 'targeted partnerships and digital initiatives' for revenue diversification (S4).

Investment arm is new (Nov 2024) with a single in-house money market fund and a stated plan to add USD and EUR strategies and 'innovative investment products' (S12, S14); no managed portfolios, third-party fund shelf, brokerage or private-markets offer found.

Fee and commission income grew 30% in H1 2026 and KIB Mobile investment-deposit openings doubled, indicating digital demand (S2, S8); Black package clients (KD 100,000+) get service benefits but no investment product (S10).
barriers: Islamic-only: any shelf must be Shariah-screened and approved by the Shari'ah Supervisory Board (S1).
Leadership in transition on the evidence: earnings call led by an Acting CEO while the official site lists the CEO (S4, S1).
Digital investment is retail-banking led and focused on payments, onboarding and financing journeys (S8); KIB Invest is small and focused on sukuk arranging and one fund (S7, S14).
Latest annual report posted is AR 2024; no vendor or platform commitments for wealth are disclosed.

discrepancies.detail: Official page (B26 read 2026-10-12, S1), the 26 Jul 2026 H1 results coverage (S7, S25), KIB's 5 Sep 2026 sukuk release (S9), KIB Invest's board page (S21) and the 11 Oct 2026 IMF/World Bank delegation release (S26, S27) all give Raed Jawad Bukhamseen as Vice Chairman and CEO. The Boursa Kuwait minutes (S20) and English transcript (S4) of the 29 Jul 2026 H1 call list Jassim Al-Abdulhadi (GM Real Estate on the site) as Acting CEO; the 27 Apr 2026 Q1 call had only the Deputy CEO and CFO (S35); the 30 Jun 2026 statements are signed by the Chairman and Deputy CEO (S2).
discrepancies.resolution: Bukhamseen recorded as current CEO (most recent official statement 11 Oct 2026). The acting arrangement is recorded on Al-Abdulhadi's entry as a dated fact; no Boursa Kuwait disclosure of a CEO change or leave was found, so its dates and reason remain open.

discrepancies.detail: KIB website biography (S1, read 2026-10-12 by B26): 'General Manager, Digital Transformation and Innovation Department'. KIB press releases of 4 Apr 2024 (S31, Arabic) and 7 Oct 2026 (S28): 'General Manager of Digital Innovation and Data Intelligence'.
discrepancies.resolution: The release wording is used as the title because it is the most recent official statement (7 Oct 2026) and matches the 2024 usage; the website wording is kept in appointed_note. Same person and department on the evidence.

discrepancies.detail: KIB website biography (S1): '33+ years in finance incl. 22 in Islamic banking'; KIB Invest board biography (S21): 'over 32 years ... including 21 years in Islamic banking'.
discrepancies.resolution: Difference reflects biographies written a year apart; the dated career facts (Aug 2014 joining, May 2016 promotion, Sep 2015–Sep 2018 acting CEO) agree. Recorded as quoted.

open_items: CEO / acting CEO: Raed Bukhamseen is quoted as Vice Chairman and CEO on 26 Jul 2026 (S25), 5 Sep 2026 (S9) and 11 Oct 2026 (S26, S27), while Jassim Al-Abdulhadi is listed as Acting CEO in the Boursa Kuwait minutes of the 29 Jul 2026 call (S20) and the Q1 call of 27 Apr 2026 had no CEO (S35). No disclosure of the acting arrangement's dates or reason was found; check Boursa Kuwait disclosures (main site and docs host answer 403 to this environment).

AR 2025 not yet posted on the Annual Reports page at 12 Oct 2026; ownership above 5% is from AR 2024 (31 Dec 2024) apart from the 37.38% Bukhamseen Group figure at 30 Jun 2026 from the 1H 2026 presentation. PIFSS and KIA 2026 stakes unconfirmed.

KIB Invest: CEO Jamal Hamad Al-Barrak confirmed current (official page S22; quoted 25 May 2026, S23). AUM still not disclosed. LEAD FOR THE CAPABILITIES PASS (not edited here): kibinvest.com (checked 2026-10-12) shows three funds - Al Dawli Invest Islamic KD Money Market Fund, KIB USD Money Market Fund (inception 1 Oct 2026) and KIB Kuwait Equity Fund (inception 13 Mar 2025) - plus discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management, custody, investment banking/advisory and a 'fully digital investment platform' app that lets clients 'trade stocks'; Head of Digital Services and Online Trading added to people. The site links a company LinkedIn page (https://www.linkedin.com/company/kibinvest/), not recorded in linkedin_company (outside this pass). KIB Invest board nominations for the 2026-2029 term closed 8 Sep 2026 (S23) - re-check its board after the election.
Financing receivables note (gross financing, provisions) not read; the figure is the line on the statement of financial position.
Boursa Kuwait code and Arabic name not confirmed from sources opened (left null / unconfirmed).

Premium package / Premium Segment: KIB's 4 Aug 2026 release (S29) gives eligibility of monthly salary KD 1,500-2,999 or total deposits KD 30,000-99,999 - lead for the capabilities pass (segments entry still says threshold not shown). Black package thresholds are as published (undated).

LinkedIn: no profile verified for any person (the search tool declines name-based look-ups; role-based searches returned no profile matches; KIB's site, which might link profiles, was blocked this pass). Company LinkedIn not recorded.

No wealth or private banking head exists on the evidence: retail is led by GM Othman Tawfiqi (confirmed Oct 2026, S28), Deputy GM Nawaf Al-Khrayef (Aug 2026, S30) and AGM Abdulaziz Al-Shammari (Oct 2026, S28; not added). Other 2026 appointments seen but not added (not wealth/digital roles): Abdulrahman Al-Sadah, GM Risk Management (Al-Rai, 6 May 2026); Ma'ab Al-Qassem, GM International Banking and Financial Institutions (in the Oct 2026 delegation, S26); Ahmad AlKazemi, GM Commercial Banking (Kuwait Times, undated). Board members named in Oct 2026: Marzook Khaled Al-Marzook and Abdulrazzaq Salah Al-Mutawa (S26); Dr Abdullah Abdul Samad Marafi is a KIB board member since 2010 and KIB Invest Vice Chairman (S21); none added.

Q3 2026 results not yet published at 12 Oct 2026; add when released. Abdullah Al-Asousi appointment date (June 2026) rests on a search summary; ebankIT interview does not confirm a vendor relationship.

People pass X19 blocked sources (2026-10-12): kib.com.kw answered every URL (leadership page S1, PDFs S2-S6, releases S8-S9, product pages) with a '302 Security Redirect' to /404.html and refused the Python TLS handshake; albawaba.com answered 403 'Malformed Browser Request' (S14, S16 and the Q1 2026 results release remain search-result-only); boursakuwait.com.kw and docs.boursakuwait.com.kw answered 403 (2023 rights-issue prospectus with board/executive bios and the Q1 2026 call transcript S35 not opened; the ifsahdocs host did serve S20); web.archive.org was unreachable through the proxy; the Zawya release 'New General Manager of Wholesale Banking at KIB' answered HTTP 400. Re-read S1 and AR 2024/2025 governance pages for board members' bios, the Shari'ah board and Al-Mubaraki's GM date when the site is reachable.
